stories.title: Sánchez no asistirá a la habitual recepción que ofrece Trump por la Asamblea de la ONU

en.title: Sánchez will not attend the usual reception offered by Trump for the UN Assembly
en.summary: Spanish government sources cite scheduling reasons for Prime Minister Sánchez's absence from a traditional reception hosted by Trump during the UN Assembly, despite having no official activities scheduled at that time.

stories.title: Crisis en Ceuta y actualidad política, directo | El Congreso retira definitivamente la acreditación como redactor a Vito Quiles

en.title: Crisis in Ceuta and political news, live | Congress permanently removes Vito Quiles' accreditation as journalist
en.summary: Spain's foreign minister will meet his Moroccan counterpart in New York to address migrant returns from Ceuta, while Congress has permanently revoked journalist Vito Quiles' press accreditation due to repeated serious violations.

stories.title: El Congreso retira definitivamente la acreditación de prensa a Vito Quiles por reiteradas faltas "muy graves"

en.title: Congress permanently removes Vito Quiles' press accreditation for repeated "very serious" violations
en.summary: Congress has permanently revoked the press credentials of journalist Vito Quiles following repeated serious infractions, with the decision approved by PSOE and Sumar votes while the PP abstained.

stories.title: El Congreso retira a Vito Quiles la credencial de prensa definitivamente

en.title: Congress permanently removes Vito Quiles' press credential
en.summary: Congress has permanently revoked the press accreditation of EDATV employee Vito Quiles for accumulated serious violations, marking the first time this maximum sanction has been applied since the regulations were reformed.

stories.title: Sánchez hace un feo a Trump y no acudirá a su recepción en Nueva York

en.title: Sánchez snubs Trump and will not attend his reception in New York
en.summary: Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has decided not to attend the traditional reception hosted by the United States at the UN General Assembly in New York, a significant diplomatic gesture during the annual gathering of world leaders.

stories.title: Los Mossos investigan un segundo secuestro exprés en Barcelona en menos de 24 horas

en.title: Mossos investigate second express kidnapping in Barcelona in less than 24 hours
en.summary: Catalan police are investigating a second rapid kidnapping in Barcelona that occurred in the early morning of September 20-21, when a man was forcibly taken from the Sant Martí district and later found in Girona.

stories.title: RTVE propone mantener la retirada de España de Eurovisión en el 2027 por la participación de Israel

en.title: RTVE proposes maintaining Spain's withdrawal from Eurovision in 2027 due to Israel's participation
en.summary: Spain's public broadcaster RTVE has proposed that the country remain withdrawn from the Eurovision Song Contest in 2027, citing concerns related to Israel's participation in the competition.

stories.title: El hijo de Cindy Crawford habría muerto de «sobredosis y un paro cardíaco», según las primeras informaciones

en.title: Cindy Crawford's son reportedly died of "overdose and cardiac arrest" according to preliminary information
en.summary: Presley Gerber, 27-year-old son of supermodel Cindy Crawford, died at a rehabilitation center in Los Angeles, with preliminary reports indicating overdose and cardiac arrest as contributing factors.

stories.title: Los Mossos investigan el secuestro de un hombre obligado a subir a un coche en Barcelona y liberado más tarde en Girona

en.title: Mossos investigate kidnapping of man forced into car in Barcelona and later released in Girona
en.summary: Police in Catalonia are investigating an abduction where a man was forcibly placed in a vehicle in Barcelona and subsequently freed in Girona. Authorities suggest the incident may be connected to disputes among drug traffickers.

stories.title: Presley Gerber murió de una “sobredosis fatal” y un paro cardíaco

en.title: Presley Gerber died of a "fatal overdose" and cardiac arrest
en.summary: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, died following a fatal overdose and heart failure. He had struggled with drug addiction and mental health issues for many years.

stories.title: Los Mossos investigan un tercer secuestro exprés en menos de un mes en Catalunya

en.title: Mossos investigate third express kidnapping in less than a month in Catalonia
en.summary: Police are investigating another abduction in Barcelona where a man was forcibly taken from Sant Martí district early morning and found hours later in Girona. This marks a third similar incident within a month in the region.

stories.title: Presley Gerber, el hijo de Cindy Crawford, murió de una sobredosis

en.title: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford, died of an overdose
en.summary: Presley Gerber, age 27, died in Los Angeles following an overdose. The son of model Cindy Crawford had long battled addiction and mental health problems.

stories.title: El Gobierno renueva a Mariano Bacigalupo como consejero de la CNMV y nombra al economista Ángel Estrada

en.title: The Government renews Mariano Bacigalupo as CNMV advisor and appoints economist Ángel Estrada
en.summary: Spain's Economy Minister Carlos Cuerpo has appointed Ángel Estrada García as advisor to the National Securities Market Commission and renewed Mariano Bacigalupo Saggese's mandate for two additional years.

stories.title: El Ibex se anima con otro freno del petróleo

en.title: The Ibex gains momentum with another oil decline
en.summary: The Spanish stock index aims to consolidate recent gains while oil prices recover above 100 dollars and technology stocks moderate their advances.

stories.title: Los inversores internacionales alcanzan un récord del 50,4% en la Bolsa española

en.title: International investors reach a record 50.4% on the Spanish stock exchange
en.summary: Foreign investors now control a historic 50.4% of shares listed on Spain's stock exchange, while domestic families increase their participation to 16.7%, with BlackRock, Vanguard, and Capital Group leading by investment volume.

stories.title: ¿Qué activo será más rentable en los próximos cinco años?

en.title: Which asset will be most profitable in the next five years?
en.summary: Emerging market equities are projected to deliver the highest annualized returns at 8% in euros for 2027-2031, according to investment management firm Robeco's latest market forecast report.

stories.title: El dueño de Riotinto vuela en Bolsa con los récords del cobre

en.title: Rio Tinto owner soars on stock market with copper records
en.summary: Rio Tinto's share price is rising alongside record copper prices. Analysts from JPMorgan and RBC expect the stock rally to continue.
